corrections: Translated and reread the final Strings/Locations source ordinals 356–391 directly from English, covering remaining nut hints, resort scheduling, Lost and Found, field-office donations, island shop boxes, the Shrine of Challenge, Gil’s telephone reward and late-game farm notices.

Applied locked Island Resort, Lost and Found, Special Order, Ginger Island, Qi, Magma Sprite, Item Recovery Service and character terminology while preserving every placeholder, quantity, price, caret, dialogue marker, indent and line break.

Removed gendered player wording from the active-request and telephone lines, clarified the completed fossil-set reward, and rendered Abigail’s grave inscription naturally without weakening its meaning.
Corrected the Saloon money-box signature to locked Гас while reviewing the complete NPC name asset.
